Gas price spikes added ₹4,000 to ₹5,000 per ton in costs, impacting margins on the 30-40 day existing order book.
Working capital payables increased due to the adoption of vendor bill discounting facilities.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East caused natural gas supply disruptions and temporary 35% production cuts.

tax_litigation.status: Bansal Steel & Power Limited (BSPL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Bansal Wire industries Limited, had filed a case before the Hon’ble High Court in 2020 challenging various income tax demands raised against the Company for the period prior to the commencement of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). The Hon’ble High Court, vide Case No. 6855, pronounced its order in favour of the Company on April 30, 2026. However, the Income Tax Department had not given effect to the order and the outstanding demands continued to appear in the records until the last quarter. On persistent follow-up with the Income Tax Department, all outstanding income tax demands, including related interest and penalties, have now been reduced to Nil. Accordingly, there are currently no outstanding income tax demands against the Company.

operating_notes.text: Dadri Unit C Shed fire on Oct 2, 2025 resulted in estimated inventory loss of ₹1.54 Cr while insurance valuation for capital assets remains pending.
FY26 operating cash flow rose significantly to ₹333.08 Cr from negative ₹150.96 Cr in FY25.
Sales volumes reached 4,58,055 MT in FY26 (+33% YoY).
Operating cash flow reached ₹333 Cr in FY26, targeting ₹600 Cr cumulative over FY26-FY27.
Installed capacity reached 6,80,000 metric tons after adding 1,20,000 tons at Dadri in FY26.
GST appellate order for FY2023-24 reduced a ₹39,87,711 demand to ₹44,491 paid, balance ₹39,43,220 set to nil; allegations covered e-way bill, blocked/excess ITC and RODTEP licence sale tax.
Stock split of equity shares from face value of ₹5 to ₹1 implemented with record date October 16, 2026.

timeline.summary: Bansal Wire Industries Limited schedules earnings call on **30 April 2026 at 15:30 IST** for Q4 & FY2026 results, led by **Pranav Bansal (MD & CEO)** and **Ghanshyam Das Gujrati (CFO)**.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,136.36 Cr (+20.9% YoY), net profit ₹40.07 Cr (+21.0% YoY).
Bansal Wire reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹1,136.36 Cr (+20.9% YoY) and net profit of ₹40.07 Cr (+21.0% YoY).
Bansal Wire Industries Limited shared the earnings call audio for Q4-FY26 results, approved by the Board on April 29, 2026, via Sumit Gupta’s digital signature.
Delhi High Court quashed pre-resolution plan income tax demands of ₹8.89 Cr against wholly owned subsidiary Bansal Steel & Power Limited.
Bansal Wire hosted its Q4 & FY26 earnings call discussing capacity expansion plans, cash flow performance, and near-term gas supply headwinds.
2026-05-18: GST appellate authority set aside ₹39.43 lakh of a ₹39.88 lakh FY24 demand against Bansal Wire, leaving ₹44,491 paid.

Bansal Wire Industries Limited invites analysts and investors to its earnings conference call on October 23, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST to discuss Q2 & H1 FY27 results, featuring **Pranav Bansal (MD & CEO)**, **Ghanshyam Das Gujrati (CFO)**, and **Manu Jain (Head IR)**.
Bansal Wire Industries reported standalone Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,276.25 Cr and PAT of ₹40.87 Cr.
Bansal Wire Industries Limited provided link to audio recording of Earnings Conference Call for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, held on October 23, 2026.
